title: Per-turn telemetry record
description: One turn-record captures the telemetry snapshot for a single turn, sourced from the fork's /profile, /turns, and /experts?turn=N endpoints. Schema_version 1 — bumped from run-record v1 to distinguish turn-level vs probe-level records.

schema_version.description: Turn-record schema version. Distinguishes from run-record v1 (probe-level).

turn_seq.description: Monotonic turn sequence number, sourced from /turns seq. Reset on session restart.

turn_id.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of turn start (UTC). Unique per turn within a session.

profile.description: Per-turn timing + token counts, mirroring the fork's /profile ProfileTurn object verbatim (server-atlas.cpp profile_json). Phase timings are honest 0.0 until phase capture lands in the fork.

wall_s.description: Wall-clock time for the turn in seconds, from /profile.

forwards.description: Number of forward passes (decode steps) in this turn, from /profile.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of prompt tokens processed in this turn, from /profile.

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens generated (decode output) in this turn, from /profile.

slot.description: Slot id that served this turn, from /profile.

ts.description: Unix epoch seconds when the turn was recorded, from /profile.

expert_disk_s.description: Phase timing: expert weights disk-load seconds. Live fork emits honest 0.0 until phase capture lands.

expert_wait_s.description: Phase timing: expert prefetch wait seconds. Live fork emits honest 0.0 until phase capture lands.

expert_matmul_s.description: Phase timing: expert matmul seconds. Live fork emits honest 0.0 until phase capture lands.

attention_s.description: Phase timing: attention seconds. Live fork emits honest 0.0 until phase capture lands.

lm_head_s.description: Phase timing: lm-head seconds. Live fork emits honest 0.0 until phase capture lands.

experts_snapshot.description: EMAP snapshot from /experts?turn=N for this turn, mirroring the fork wire object verbatim (src/llama-cpp/tools/server/server-atlas.cpp experts_json_at): map and hits are hex STRINGS (hex_of byte encoding), seq is the global geometry seq, turn_seq echoes the turn. null when telemetry is disabled or snapshot not captured. Tier transforms (tier_summary etc.) belong to the COLLECTOR, not the record format — Colibri lineage is hex strings everywhere.

rows.description: Number of rows in the EMAP grid, from wire /experts rows.

cols.description: Number of columns (experts per layer) in the EMAP grid, from wire /experts cols.

map.description: Hex STRING of per-cell EMAP bytes (encode_cell tiers), from wire /experts map (hex_of). Length is rows*cols*2 chars. NEVER an array.

hits.description: Hex STRING hit/miss bitmap for this turn, from wire /experts hits (hex_of). Zero-filled when the turn has no hits yet.

seq.description: Global geometry seq (g_seq) at capture time, from wire /experts seq.

turn_seq.description: Turn sequence number this snapshot was captured for, from wire /experts turn_seq. Must equal the top-level turn_seq.

telemetry_enabled.description: Wire /experts telemetry_enabled. Always true when a snapshot object is present (absent-telemetry is represented by null snapshot).

geometry.description: Model geometry block, from wire /experts geometry. Optional in the record (consumers that already know the model may drop it); when present it mirrors the wire keys.

engine_id.description: FNV-1a64 of model path, from wire geometry.

model_hash.description: GGUF filename or full-weights digest, from wire geometry.

dense_prefix.description: Number of leading dense layers, from wire geometry.

moe_rows.description: Number of MoE rows, from wire geometry.

nextn_rows.description: Number of next-N (MTP) rows, from wire geometry.

n_expert_used.description: Experts used per token, from wire geometry.

engine_id.description: FNV-1a64 of model path, per route_trace.h discipline.

llama_cpp_commit.description: Fork commit hash at turn capture time.

atlas_stage.description: Atlas pipeline stage that produced this record.

session_id.description: Logical session identifier (turn_seq resets on session restart).

telemetry_enabled.description: Whether engine telemetry (HYDRA_EXPERT_STATS) was active for this turn. REQUIRED on every record — the telemetry-off example carries telemetry_enabled:false explicitly.
